description: Family-wide scan: superpose AlphaFold models of all human PF02466 members plus NDUFA11, PXMP2, MPV17 and TMEM126B on stendomycin-bound Tim17 and score the cavity lining
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}; os.makedirs("/tmp/st",exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,o): open(o,"wb").write(requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=180).content)
dl("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9N84.cif","/tmp/st/9N84.cif")
def parse_cif(p):
    lines=open(p).read().splitlines(); rows=[];cols=None;i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith("loop_"):
            hdr=[];j=i+1
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith("_"): hdr.append(lines[j].strip()); j+=1
            if hdr and hdr[0].startswith("_atom_site."):
                cols=[h.split(".")[1] for h in hdr]; k=j
                while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith("#"):
                    q=lines[k].split()
                    if len(q)==len(cols): rows.append(q)
                    k+=1
                i=k; continue
            i=j; continue
        i+=1
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
def parse_pdb(p):
    rec=[]
    for L in open(p):
        if L.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            rec.append(dict(group_PDB=L[:6].strip(),label_atom_id=L[12:16].strip(),label_comp_id=L[17:20].strip(),
             auth_asym_id=L[21].strip(),auth_seq_id=L[22:26].strip(),Cartn_x=L[30:38],Cartn_y=L[38:46],
             Cartn_z=L[46:54],B_iso_or_equiv=L[60:66]))
    return pd.DataFrame(rec)
def clean(d):
    d=d.copy()
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: d[c]=d[c].astype(float)
    d["auth_seq_id"]=pd.to_numeric(d["auth_seq_id"],errors="coerce")
    d["B_iso_or_equiv"]=pd.to_numeric(d["B_iso_or_equiv"],errors="coerce")
    return d
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def ca_of(d):
    c=d[d.label_atom_id=="CA"].drop_duplicates("auth_seq_id").sort_values("auth_seq_id")
    return (c[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float), c.auth_seq_id.values.astype(int),
            "".join(t2o[r] for r in c.label_comp_id))
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); V,_,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt; return R,qc-pc@R
def ap(P,R,t): return P@R+t
def refine(P,Q,pr,d0,Ln):
    idx=np.array(pr); A=P[idx[:,0]]; B=Q[idx[:,1]]; R,t=kabsch(A,B)
    for _ in range(20):
        d=np.linalg.norm(ap(A,R,t)-B,axis=1); sel=d<max(d0,3.5)
        if sel.sum()<4:
            o=np.argsort(d)[:max(4,len(d)//4)]; sel=np.zeros(len(d),bool); sel[o]=True
        R2,t2=kabsch(A[sel],B[sel])
        if np.allclose(R2,R,atol=1e-7): break
        R,t=R2,t2
    d=np.linalg.norm(ap(A,R,t)-B,axis=1)
    return float((1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/Ln),(R,t)
def dpal(sc,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=sc.shape; prev=[0.0]*(m+1); ptr=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; sl=sc.tolist()
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        cur=[0.0]*(m+1); row=sl[i-1]; pr=ptr[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=prev[j-1]+row[j-1]; b=prev[j]+gap; c=cur[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: cur[j]=a; pr[j]=0
            elif b>=c: cur[j]=b; pr[j]=1
            else: cur[j]=c; pr[j]=2
        prev=cur
    i,j=n,m; out=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=ptr[i][j]
        if k==0: out.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return out[::-1]
def tmalign(P,Q,topk=6,iters=8):
    n,m=len(P),len(Q); L=min(n,m); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5); seeds=[]
    for off in range(-(n-10),m-9):
        pr=[(i,i+off) for i in range(n) if 0<=i+off<m]
        if len(pr)>=10: seeds.append(pr)
    sc=sorted(((refine(P,Q,s,d0,L)[0],s) for s in seeds),key=lambda x:-x[0]); best=(0,None,None)
    for _,sd in sc[:topk]:
        pr=sd
        for _ in range(iters):
            tm,(R,t)=refine(P,Q,pr,d0,L)
            D=np.linalg.norm(ap(P,R,t)[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2)
            np_=dpal(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if len(np_)<4: break
            tm2,Rt2=refine(P,Q,np_,d0,L)
            if tm2>best[0]: best=(tm2,np_,Rt2)
            if np_==pr: break
            pr=np_
    tm,pairs,(R,t)=best
    return tm,pairs,R,t

ref=clean(parse_cif("/tmp/st/9N84.cif"))
refat=ref[(ref.auth_asym_id=="A")&(ref.group_PDB=="ATOM")&(ref.label_comp_id.isin(t2o))]
refP,refI,refS=ca_of(refat)
STEN=ref[ref.auth_asym_id=="D"][["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float)
lo=STEN.min(0)-4; hi=STEN.max(0)+4; step=0.8
G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(*[np.arange(lo[i],hi[i],step) for i in range(3)],indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)
site=G[np.sqrt(((G[:,None,:]-STEN[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min(1)<4.5]
cav_y=[7,16,17,19,20,21,24,64,65,66,68,69,70,72,73,76,80,91,98,118,121,122,125,126]

panel={"TIMM17A":"Q99595","TIMM17B":"O60830","TIMM22":"Q9Y584","TIMM23":"O14925","TIMM23B":"Q5SRD1",
       "TIMMDC1":"Q9NPL8","NDUFA11":"Q86Y39","PXMP2":"Q9NR77","MPV17":"P39210","TMEM126B":"Q8IUX1"}
res=[]; detail={}
for name,acc in panel.items():
    try: dl(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb", f"/tmp/st/{acc}.pdb")
    except Exception as e: print(name,"dl fail",e); continue
    at=clean(parse_pdb(f"/tmp/st/{acc}.pdb")); at=at[at.label_comp_id.isin(t2o)]
    at=at[at.B_iso_or_equiv>=60]                     # keep confidently modelled residues only
    P,I,Sq=ca_of(at)
    if len(P)<60: print(name,"too few confident residues",len(P)); continue
    tm,pairs,R,t=tmalign(P,refP)
    xyz=ap(at[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values.astype(float),R,t)
    D=np.sqrt(((site[:,None,:]-xyz[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)); dmin=D.min(1); near=D.argmin(1)
    vol=(dmin>3.0).sum()*step**3
    lin=(dmin>3.0)&(dmin<5.0); sub=at.iloc[np.unique(near[lin])]
    nac=sub[sub.label_comp_id.isin(["ASP","GLU"])].auth_seq_id.nunique()
    nbc=sub[sub.label_comp_id.isin(["LYS","ARG"])].auth_seq_id.nunique()
    acids=sorted(set(f"{t2o[r.label_comp_id]}{int(r.auth_seq_id)}" for _,r in sub[sub.label_comp_id.isin(["ASP","GLU"])].iterrows()))
    ref2q={j:i for i,j in pairs}
    mapped={}
    for cres in cav_y:
        k=np.where(refI==cres)[0]
        if len(k) and k[0] in ref2q:
            qi=ref2q[k[0]]; mapped[cres]=f"{Sq[qi]}{I[qi]}"
    nac_map=sum(1 for v in mapped.values() if v[0] in "DE")
    detail[name]=mapped
    res.append(dict(protein=name, acc=acc, pfam_PF02466=name in
                ["TIMM17A","TIMM17B","TIMM22","TIMM23","TIMM23B","TIMMDC1"],
                TM_to_Tim17=round(tm,3), cavity_volume_A3=round(vol,0),
                acidic_lining=nac, basic_lining=nbc, acidic_at_mapped_cavity_pos=nac_map,
                acidic_residues=",".join(acids)))
    print(res[-1])
pan=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("TM_to_Tim17",ascending=False)
print(); print(pan.drop(columns=["acidic_residues"]).to_string(index=False))

sub=pan[pan.TM_to_Tim17>0.5].copy()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,4.8))
c=["#d1495b" if p in ("TIMMDC1","NDUFA11") else "#2e86ab" for p in sub.protein]
ax[0].bar(sub.protein, sub.acidic_lining, color=c)
ax[0].set_ylabel("acidic residues lining the Tim17 cavity site")
ax[0].set_title("Acidic cavity lining, human PF02466 fold panel (AlphaFold)")
ax[0].tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
ax[1].scatter(sub.cavity_volume_A3, sub.acidic_lining, c=c, s=90)
for _,r in sub.iterrows(): ax[1].annotate(r.protein,(r.cavity_volume_A3,r.acidic_lining),
                                          textcoords="offset points", xytext=(6,4), fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel("free cavity volume at the Tim17 site (A^3)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("acidic residues lining")
ax[1].set_title("Insertases occupy the high-volume, acidic corner")
for a_ in ax: a_.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
